page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top left and page number at the top right; a catchword "Sed" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: confilio arreptum ; ad hunc, inquam typum, & fchema duplicis regiminis, Ecclefiaftici & civilis, fuum quoque fumplerunt & exfcripferunt, omnes ubique reformati, pari injuriâ, & fraude & iniqua occupatione juris pertinentis ad Magiftratum, quâ ipfe Magiftratus, in prima reformatione exuerat viros de clero fuâ civicâ libertate, & fuo jure civili: unde enata materia litium, diffidiorum & collifionum perpetuarum inter Judicia Ecclefiaftica, & civilia, non folùm quandiu vixit Calvinus, fed & deinceps Genevæ & alibi ; imo ubique locorum in orbe reformato, qui fuam difciplinam à Calvino acceperat : minus tamen in Anglia, quam aut in Scotia, aut in Hollandia, eò quod duo tribunalia, unum ex æquo in terris agnofcerent caput, nempe Regem : non fic in Scotia, ubi Presbyteriani nunquam paffi funt, uni capiti in terris fe fubjicere præter quam Chrifto, unde factum fuerit ut major semper ibi effet tribunalium & jurifdictionum confli-ctus, quam alibi locorum, ubi reformatio obtinuit.

page.notes: Printed page 175; running head "Carolum Rupifortem." Text is set in roman with long s rendered as plain s. The word "Sed" at the foot is a catchword. Some words near the line ends are uncertain, notably "fumplerunt" and "fuum" (possibly "suum"), and "fe fubjicere" (possibly "se subjicere"); the printed form is kept as it appears.
